notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE #1
notes.content:
[p]Hello, here’s the first major update for [b]CROAK CAFE: FROM POND TO PLATE!![/b][/p][p]
[b]QUALITY OF LIFE:[/b][/p][p][u]Trash Meter:[/u][/p][p]When the trash meter is full, it will display ‘Press SHIFT/LT’ with the corresponding icon.[/p][p][u]Hold Icon:[/u][/p][p]The hold will display the F/RT icon and when hold is used, will disappear until it is empty again.[/p][p]
[b]FEATURES:[/b][/p][p][u]Rotation:[/u][/p][p]You can now rotate ingredients to give you that bit more control of where you want them to go in your cooking station![/p][p][u]Lunch Rush:[/u][/p][p]Lunch Rush is a new combo being added to the game.[/p][p]To achieve Lunch Rush, once a frog is served, a meter on the left will begin to descend, every customer served after resets the meter slightly and increases customer spawn times until you hit the LUNCH RUSH.[/p][p]This spawns customers and for a period of 15 seconds, they will want any dish so serve them ANYTHING![/p][p]
Give it a try and let me know what you think![/p][p]
[b]BUG FIXES:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Boss attacks carrying over to the next round.[/p][/*][*][p]Dialogue fixes during boss battle.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where sometimes an ingredient that isn't from this round will appear.[/p][/*][*][p]Gamepad issues with icons next to patience[/p][/*][*][p]Ratio issues for some users[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]BALANCING;[/b][/p][p]Some minor balance fixes like with the ingredients so you don’t get a ton of the same ingredient in a row. I will be consistently working on this to provide the best balance with ingredients given and dishes needed so this will be ongoing over the coming weeks and looking into a new system that will help with this. Expect minor updates on this in the future.[/p][p]
[/p][p][b]KNOWN BUGS:[/b][/p][list][*][p]The cursed tomato that will sometimes get stuck in other ingredients. This is known and is being worked on[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Ingredients sometimes being pushed out of the cooking station (spaghetti). This is known and is being worked on.[/p][/*][/list][p]
Lastly, thank you all again for playing the game, it means so much that you enjoy the game and it doesn’t stop here as I plan to add stuff in the future so stay tuned as I will be posting regularly as possible on things coming soon![/p][p][/p][p]Ribbiting regards,[/p][p]Owen[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: 23.08.25 - SMALL FIXES
notes.content:
[p][u]Just a quick update, with minor fixes/changes based on recent feedback;[/u]  

- Customers Patience takes 60 seconds to deplete compared to the original 40 seconds.[/p][p]- Gamepad UI on pause menu has 'Start' UI icon now.[/p][p]- Ingredients spawn quicker now.[/p]
